title: Off and Back
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：off　|　正文 308 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 off 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Off, in 1989 the painter carried the brush at the easel, and everybody in the studio said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning: the painter had carried the brush ② off on the same day, and nobody had asked a single question. The painter had come to the studio two seasons earlier, and spoke little of the studio he had left behind him.

The catalogue for May 1983 puts it plainer. The brush was ③ off, and the visitor who kept it wrote of the brush ④ off in the same line; nothing in the studio was ever left off for long in those days. The visitor wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every season thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the brush at the far easel, meant something else. He had come from ⑤ off, and ⑥ Off came the visitor who was to carry it back; he was not a man who explained himself, and the studio had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1996 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the catalogue. What the line asked for was that the brush be kept ⑦ off at the easel, and that everybody be ⑧ off before the May rains. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried off.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1999 she carried the brush ⑨ off before dawn when nobody else would, and ⑩ Off, she said in 2001, that was the part the studio never forgot; the catalogue still speaks of it off. She kept the brush in the same easel for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the studio never forgot how off it had all been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 离开（句末状语，置于宾语之后：carried the brush off，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 离开（作表语，说明处所或去向：the brush was off）
C. adv. 脱下（置于句首：Off, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 脱下（作后置定语，紧跟被修饰的名词：the brush off）
E. adv. 脱下（作介词宾语：from off）
F. adv. 脱下（句首强调，引起全部倒装：Off came the visitor）
G. adv. 离开（被动结构中置于过去分词之后：be kept off at the easel）
H. adv. 离开（be off 说明所在或去向：everybody be off before the rains）

answers.why: off 意为“脱下”，此处置于句首交代地点或去向：Off, in 1989 …。
off 意为“离开”，此处置于宾语之后作状语：had carried the brush off。
off 意为“离开”，此处作表语说明那件小小的画笔的去向或所在：was off。
off 意为“脱下”，此处作后置定语紧跟名词：the brush off。
off 意为“脱下”，此处作介词 from 的宾语：from off。
off 意为“脱下”，此处置于句首引起全部倒装：Off came the visitor。
off 意为“离开”，被动结构中副词置于过去分词之后：be kept off at the easel。
off 意为“离开”，be off 说明众人须在雨季前到达某处或处于某状态。
off 意为“离开”，1999 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次搬走那件小小的画笔，副词置于句末。
off 意为“脱下”，母亲 2001 年那句话以地点状语开头：Off, …。
